concept.concept: A bold retro design reading 'Principal, Teacher, Lunch Lady' stacked in three color blocks.
concept.rationale: Homeschool community is large, passionate, and underserved in mainstream retail. Back-to-school timing is perfect. Multi-role humor resonates deeply and differentiates from standard teacher shirts.

design.image_prompt:
The design prominently features the text "PRINCIPAL
TEACHER
LUNCH LADY" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration for print-on-demand t-shirt. Design features three stacked horizontal color blocks in solid colors: top block deep navy blue, middle block burnt orange, bottom block forest green. Each block contains one word centered in bold retro sans-serif typography, all caps, white text: 'PRINCIPAL' / 'TEACHER' / 'LUNCH LADY'. Text is large and fills each block proportionally with clean sharp edges. Single centered composition on plain cream background with generous margins. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Screen-print aesthetic, high contrast, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: flat vector illustration, bold retro sans-serif, three stacked solid color blocks, screen-print aesthetic, high contrast, clean sharp edges

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Principal, Teacher, Lunch Lady' is a generic list of common school staff roles with no trademark significance. None of these individual words or their combination constitute a protected mark, slogan, or reference to any specific brand, character, celebrity, or intellectual property. The retro stacked color block design concept is a common generic style. This is straightforward occupational/school-themed humor merchandise with no identifiable IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly the required text 'PRINCIPAL / TEACHER / LUNCH LADY' correctly spelled and complete. The typography is clean and legible, using bold sans-serif fonts on colored rectangular backgrounds (navy, rust, forest green). No IP risks, no quality issues, no artifacts or anatomical elements. Clean composition suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Homeschool Mom T-Shirt 'Principal Teacher Lunch Lady' Retro Design
listing.description: Wear your multiple roles with pride in this retro-styled tee celebrating the homeschool parent juggling act. Bold color-blocked design stacks 'Principal, Teacher, Lunch Lady' for a fun, honest tribute to your daily responsibilities. Great for homeschooling parents, back-to-school season, or gifting to the multi-tasking educator in your life.
